extracted.intended_audience: Applicants, licensees, and their legal representatives preparing petitions for declaratory ruling under section 310(b) of the Communications Act (FCC filings)
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements and supporting exhibits that must be included in petitions for declaratory rulings under §310(b), including disclosure of direct and indirect foreign interests, ownership diagrams, requests for specific or advance approval, certifications, and submissions to the interagency Committee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deemed compliance threshold for public companies
rubrics_metrics.description: A public company's known or reasonably should be known foreign voting interests and foreign equity interests are each compared to statutory limits: if they do not exceed 25 percent (20 percent for an eligible publicly traded licensee subject to section 310(b)(3)) of total outstanding voting shares or total outstanding shares, respectively, the company shall be deemed compliant with the applicable statutory limit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example provided showing aggregation of known foreign shareholders' shares to calculate percent foreign ownership (sum foreign shares / total outstanding shares).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant identifying information
rubrics_metrics.description: For each petitioning applicant or licensee provide name; FCC Registration Number (FRN); mailing address; place of organization; telephone number; facsimile number (if available); electronic mail address (if available); type of business organization; and name and title of officer certifying the petition information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type of business organization should be described (e.g., corporation, unincorporated association, trust, partnership, LLC, other — include description).

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party representative identification
rubrics_metrics.description: If the petitioning applicant or licensee is represented by a third party (e.g., legal counsel), specify that individual's name, the name of the firm or company, mailing address and telephone number/electronic mail address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service and authorization details for named licensees
rubrics_metrics.description: For each named licensee, list the type(s) of radio service authorized (e.g., broadcast service, cellular, microwave, mobile satellite, aeronautical fixed). For broadcast licensees, also list call sign, facility identification number (if applicable), and community of license or transmit site for each authorization covered by the petition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Associated application information
rubrics_metrics.description: If the petition is filed in connection with an application (e.g., license application, spectrum leasing arrangement, assignment or transfer of control), specify for each named applicant the File No.(s) of the associated application(s), if available, otherwise specify anticipated filing date; and the type(s) of radio services covered by each application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declaration of rule section invoked
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a statement for each petitioner whether it is requesting a declaratory ruling under §1.5000(a)(1) and/or §1.5000(a)(2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of direct interest holders (10%+ or controlling)
rubrics_metrics.description: For applicable petitions, provide the name of any individual or entity that holds, or would hold, directly 10 percent or more of the equity interests and/or voting interests, or a controlling interest, in the controlling U.S. parent (for §1.5000(a)(1)) or in each petitioning common carrier applicant or licensee (for §1.5000(a)(2)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If no such direct interests exist, the petition must state that no individual or entity holds or would hold directly 10% or more or a controlling interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entity-specific direct interest reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Where a named U.S. parent, applicant, or licensee is organized as a corporation, partnership, limited partnership/LLP, or LLC, provide entity-specific disclosures: (i) for corporations, names of any individuals/entities holding 10%+ of outstanding capital/voting stock or controlling interest; (ii) for general partnerships, names of constituent general partners; (iii) for limited partnerships/LLPs, names of general partners, any uninsulated partner regardless of equity, and insulated partners with ≥10% equity (calculated by capital contribution) and state whether partnership interests are insulated; (iv) for LLCs, names of each uninsulated member regardless of equity, insulated members with ≥10% equity (by capital contribution), and any non-equity manager(s), stating whether interests are insulated and whether the member is a manager.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insulation status must be stated based on insulation criteria in §1.5003. Note: Commission presumes general partners have a controlling (100%) voting interest and are uninsulated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of indirect interest holders (10%+ or controlling)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the name of any individual or entity that holds, or would hold, indirectly (through one or more intervening entities) 10 percent or more of the equity interests and/or voting interests, or a controlling interest, in the controlling U.S. parent (for §1.5000(a)(1)) or in the petitioning common carrier applicant or licensee (for §1.5000(a)(2)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equity and voting interests held indirectly shall be calculated in accordance with the principles set forth in §1.5002. If none exist, the petition shall specify that no individual or entity holds or would hold indirectly 10% or more or a controlling interest. The Commission presumes general partners have controlling interests and are uninsulated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship and descriptive information for disclosable interest holders
rubrics_metrics.description: For each 10 percent interest holder named in responses regarding direct and indirect interests, specify the equity interest held and the voting interest held (each to the nearest one percent); for individuals, provide citizenship; for business organizations, provide place of organization, type of business organization, and principal business(es).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For broadcast attributable interest holders, describe the nature of the attributable interest and, if applicable, specify equity and voting interest percentages, citizenship (individuals), place of organization, type, and principal business(es).

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimate of aggregate foreign ownership exhibit
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach an exhibit providing a percentage estimate of the controlling U.S. parent's aggregate direct and/or indirect foreign equity interests and its aggregate direct and/or indirect foreign voting interests (for §1.5000(a)(1)); or for §1.5000(a)(2) provide estimates of aggregate foreign equity and voting interests held directly and indirectly in the petitioning applicant(s)/licensee(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The exhibit must provide a general description of methods used to determine the percentages and a statement addressing circumstances prompting the filing and demonstrating that the public interest would be served by grant of the petition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ownership and control structure exhibit and diagram
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach an exhibit describing the ownership and control structure of the applicant(s)/licensee(s), including an ownership diagram and identification of the real party-in-interest disclosed in any companion applications. The diagram should illustrate the petitioner's vertical ownership structure including the controlling U.S. parent and depict direct and indirect ownership (equity and voting) interests held by individuals/entities named in the petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For common carrier/aeronautical applicants depict the direct and indirect ownership (equity and voting) held by named individuals/entities; for broadcast depict attributable interest holders. Multiple petitioners may be depicted in a single or multiple diagrams. All controlling interests should be labeled as such.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for specific approval and identification thresholds
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify and request specific approval for each foreign individual/entity for which approval is sought and provide the respective percentages of equity and/or voting interests (to the nearest one percent) that each holds or would hold directly and/or indirectly in the controlling U.S. parent (for §1.5000(a)(1)) or in each petitioning common carrier applicant or licensee (for §1.5000(a)(2)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each petitioning broadcast, common carrier or aeronautical applicant/licensee must identify and request specific approval for any foreign individual/entity or group that holds or would hold directly and/or indirectly more than 5% of the equity and/or voting interests or a controlling interest, unless the foreign investment is exempt under the exemptions paragraph. Equity and voting interests held indirectly are calculated per §§1.5002 and 1.5003; for direct holdings in partnerships or LLCs calculate per the specified note. Two or more individuals/entities are a 'group' if they agreed to act together to acquire/hold/vote/dispose of interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exemptions from specific approval
rubrics_metrics.description: A foreign investment is exempt from specific approval where: (i) the foreign individual/entity holds, directly and/or indirectly, no more than 10% of the equity and/or voting interests of the U.S. parent or petitioning applicant/licensee; and (ii) the foreign individual/entity does not hold or intend to hold or influence control, and does not take actions to change or influence control.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commission presumes certain categories satisfy exemption: (A) institutional investors in public companies eligible to report under Exchange Act Rule 13d-1(b) (subject to aggregation rules and exceptions for those required to report under 13d-1(a)); (B) privately held corporations with a shareholders' or similar voting agreement that prohibits foreign holder active involvement and limits voting/consent rights to specified minority shareholder protections; (C) privately held partnerships/LLCs/LLPs where the foreign holder is 'insulated' per §1.5003. Notes explain how general partners/uninsulated members are treated and how indirect holdings via intervening partnerships/LLCs are attributed for voting interest calculations (see §1.5002 references). Commission may treat aggregated institutional holdings up to 10% as exempt under conditions described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minority shareholder protections (examples and Commission discretion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerated minority shareholder protections that, if present in a shareholders' or similar agreement, may support exemption: (i) power to prevent sale/pledge of substantially all assets or voluntary bankruptcy/ liquidation; (ii) power to prevent contracts with majority shareholders/affiliates; (iii) power to prevent corporation guaranteeing obligations of majority shareholders/affiliates; (iv) power to purchase additional interest to prevent dilution on new share issuance; (v) power to prevent change of existing legal rights/preferences of shareholders as in charter/bylaws; (vi) power to prevent amendment of charter/bylaws regarding the matters in (i)-(v). The Commission reserves the right to consider other voting or consent rights as permissible minority protections on a case-by-case basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information required for each foreign individual or entity named
rubrics_metrics.description: For each foreign individual/entity named in response to the specific approval paragraph, provide: (1) for individuals—citizenship and principal business(es); (2) for business organizations—place of organization, type of business organization, and principal business(es).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additionally: (A) for common carrier/aeronautical applicants/licensees, identify any individual/entity that holds or would hold directly and/or indirectly 10%+ of the equity/voting interests in the foreign entity for which approval is requested and specify citizenship or place of legal organization for each such interest holder (indirect interests calculated under §1.5002); (B) for broadcast applicants/licensees, name any individual/entity that holds or would hold directly and/or indirectly an attributable interest in the foreign entity (calculated per Notes to §73.3555). If no such interest holders exist, the petition must state that fact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for advance approval to increase interests
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitioner may request advance approval for identified foreign individuals/entities to increase their direct and/or indirect equity and/or voting interests above specified percentages at some future time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For petitions under §1.5000(a)(1): where a named foreign holds or would hold a de jure or de facto controlling interest in the controlling U.S. parent, petitioner may request approval to increase interests up to any amount including 100%; petitioner must specify maximum percentages or request approval up to 100%. For petitions under §1.5000(a)(1) and/or (2): where a named foreign holds or would hold a non-controlling interest, petitioner may request approval to increase interests up to any non-controlling amount not to exceed 49.99%, specifying maximum percentages or requesting approval up to 49.99%.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification of petition contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Each applicant, licensee, or spectrum lessee filing a petition for declaratory ruling shall certify to the information contained in the petition in accordance with §1.16 and the requirements of §1.5000(c)(1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of petition materials and responses to the Committee
rubrics_metrics.description: For petitions subject to referral to the executive branch under §1.40001, the petitioner must (1) submit responses to standard questions (prior to or at same time as filing with the Commission) directly to the Committee for the Assessment of Foreign Participation in the U.S. Telecommunications Services Sector (Committee) pursuant to subpart CC of this part; and (2) provide a complete and unredacted copy of its FCC petition(s), including file and docket numbers, to the Committee within three business days of filing with the Commission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard questions and instructions are available on the FCC website; required info shall be submitted separately from the petition and directly to the Committee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broadcast applicant certifications (responsibilities and penalties)
rubrics_metrics.description: Broadcast applicants and licensees must certify to: (i) designation of a U.S.-located point of contact who is a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident for execution of lawful requests and as an agent for legal service of process; (ii)(A) responsibility for continuing accuracy and completeness of all information submitted and agreement to inform the Commission and Committee of substantial/significant changes while petition is pending; (B) after petition no longer pending for purposes of §1.65, notify Commission and Committee of any changes in petitioner/contact information promptly and within 30 days; (iii) understanding that failure to fulfill these conditions or submitting materially false information may subject petitioner to remedies including revocation/termination of the declaratory ruling, authorization, or license, and criminal/civil penalties including those under 18 U.S.C. 1001.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common carrier certifications and law-enforcement access obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: Common carrier applicants, licensees, or spectrum lessees must certify to: (i) compliance with all applicable Communications Assistance for Law Enforcement Act (CALEA) requirements and related rules and FCC orders; (ii) making communications to, from, or within the United States, and records thereof, available in a form and location that permits them to be subject to valid lawful requests or legal process under U.S. law (including Wiretap Act, Stored Communications Act, Pen Register/Trap and Trace, and other court orders/subpoenas); (iii) designate a U.S.-located point of contact who is a U.S. citizen or lawful U.S. permanent resident (continued in next portion of rule).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These certifications bind petitioners to enable lawful access to communications and records in accordance with U.S. law and FCC rules; designation of a U.S. point of contact is required.
